title: Updated Personal AI
content: The portfolio assistant uses a single OpenAI Luna agent with tools. The server searches a small local knowledge corpus and supplies relevant facts before generating a reply. It can queue portfolio navigation, email, and reminder actions when the visitor enables tools and requests an action. The concierge uses the same agent with local search only. Technologies: OpenAI Responses API, gpt-5.6-luna, Next.js, TypeScript. Evidence: implementation in this repository; public case-study media describes an earlier version. No measured performance claims.

title: Stock AI
content: Stock AI provides command-driven company research, a help command, an upcoming earnings calendar, and a monitor for future company events such as product releases and conferences. Its authored case study lists Telegram, Gemini, AWS, and Redis. Evidence: app/(pages)/projects/stock-ai/Features.tsx and TechStack.tsx; no investment returns, predictive accuracy, or measured performance are documented.

title: Reminder API
content: RemAInder API is a reminder API with Redis, authentication, and AI interaction. The portfolio includes a reminder playground at /projects/reminders and a demo at https://reminder-demo-app.vercel.app/. Evidence: components/Landing/Project/RemainderApi.tsx. No measured latency or throughput is documented.

title: Shortcuts Calendar

title: XCuisite
